bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
want="0cfc593e1883c2e0a27748d18d8868118354eac1"
test "$(git rev-parse "$want")" = "$want"
{ printf 'PR47_USERBOT_CODE_ACTIVATION_PREFLIGHT\n'; printf 'CURRENT_WORKTREE_DIRTY_FOR_SCRIPTS='; git status --porcelain -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py | wc -l; printf 'CURRENT_CLIENT_ACTION_PRESENT='; grep -q profile_topics_readback scripts/userbot_test_client.py && echo yes || echo no; printf 'CURRENT_HANDLER_ACTION_PRESENT='; grep -q profile_topics_readback scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py && echo yes || echo no; printf 'PR47_HANDLER_ACTION_PRESENT='; git show "$want":scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | grep -q profile_topics_readback && echo yes || echo no; printf 'PR47_CLIENT_ACTION_PRESENT='; git show "$want":scripts/userbot_test_client.py | grep -q profile_topics_readback && echo yes || echo no; printf 'SERVICE_EXEC_START='; systemctl --user show -p ExecStart --value gace-userbot-verify.service | sed -E 's#(/home/[^ ]+)[/]scripts/userbot_keepalive.py#<REPO>/scripts/userbot_keepalive.py#g' | cut -c 1-450; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
